item.title: Flytipping and incorrext use of disposal bins, 10th August
item.description:
Hi I have reached out to you twice in the past with regards to one of my neighbours (20 Fairthorn) regularly flytipping and improperly using the rubbish bins. This is happening on a weekly basis and because we share the same bins we found ourselves with uncollected rubbish because of him. You have so far taken no action so we feel our complaints are going unheard. We really need you to do something about it or I will escalate it further and report your poor service as well. We have just returned from our 10 days holidays and please see what we found outside the property. The recycling bin was also not collected with a red card because it has wrong items in it. We wont know where to put our recycling till the items are removed and I know he wont do that. Please get in touch ASAP. Thanks

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Fairthorn Road, Charlton
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Car taking up space, been there weeks, 10th August
item.description:
I've checked on the website and this car does not have a valid Mot, it takes up a space that could be used by the residents of the flats, or guests, as parking is often reserved around the blocks to one space. The car, I would think, has been there weeks now and it takes up a prominent space. This has been particularly difficult when people with disabled badges cannot find somewhere to park near the flat entrances and this car is taking up a space unnecessarily.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Tanners Close, Crayford, Greater London

item.title: Trees laden with fruit falling randomly onto pavements., 10th August
item.description:
These trees are never pruned and are growing out of control with overhanging fruit into Overhill Way. One tree is full of berries which are continually being squashed onto the pavement and road. The apple tree is full of apples which randomly fall to the ground. The pavement is dangerous and slippery and will cause an accident either on the pavement or the road. An apple fell and almost hit my 86 year old mother on the head. People now have to walk in the road to avoid an accident. These trees need urgent pruning to avoid accidents and legal recourse.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 2a, Overhill Way, Park Langley, Greater London
